📖 How to use

  1. Enter the vehicle price, down payment and trade-in value.
  2. Set the APR and loan term in months.
  3. Read your monthly payment, total interest and total cost instantly.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the monthly payment calculated?

With the standard amortizing formula M = P·r(1+r)^n / ((1+r)^n − 1) on the financed amount (price minus down payment and trade-in).

Does this include taxes and fees?

No — add your local sales tax, title and dealer fees to the vehicle price first for a true out-the-door number.

Is a longer term better?

It lowers the monthly payment but raises total interest and the risk of owing more than the car is worth.
